explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/847: for an infinite A ⊆ ℕ such that, for some ε > 0, every n-element subset contains a 3-AP-free subset of size ≥ εn, must A be a finite union of 3-AP-free sets? (no — Reiher, Rödl and Sales). The Lean statement negates: ∀ infinite A with HasFew3APs A (∃ ε > 0, every finite B ⊆ A has a 3-AP-free C ⊆ B with |C| ≥ ε|B|), A = ⋃_{i<n} S_i with each S_i ThreeAPFree. A finite cover by 3-AP-free sets is the same as a finite colouring without monochromatic 3-APs, so RRS24's example gives the negation. Faithful.
